questions.question:
Study the given bar graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be1c76975f227e248868df26a210277fd54e5d588eff034e5e60f87659fea851.png] 

What was the percentage (in%) drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph showing the production of food grains by a State over the years (in 1000 tons).

Production in 1991 = 60 (thousand tons)

Production in 1992 = 45 (thousand tons)

**Calculations:**

Drop in production from 1991 to 1992 = Production in 1991 - Production in 1992

Drop = 60 - 45 = 15 (thousand tons)

Percentage drop = (Drop in production / Production in the initial year) × 100

Percentage drop = (15 / 60) × 100

Percentage drop = (1 / 4) × 100

Percentage drop = 25%

**∴ The percentage drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992 was 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38fc13dd52ff04eea293633f72d7dddec6d25752d5ac6ddd330487542176b555.png]
questions.solution:
Formula used:

Required % = frac{{Total of A}}{{Total of C}} × 100

Calculation:

Total earnings of Agent A from 2018 to 2022 = 60 + 70 + 75 = 205 lakh

Total earnings of Agent C from 2020 to 2022 = 70 + 65 + 85 = 220 lakh

= (205)/(220) × 100

⇒ .9318 × 100

⇒ 93.18%

**∴ The required percentage is 93.18%**

questions.question:
The bar graph below shows the number of people watching films of their favourite genres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8022c5cb7ce8456508a7909a2b96a95593cc62651416a3fc349840bfe489e4e1.png] 

The number of people watching Action, Sci-fi and Animation films is what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the number of people watching Drama and Horror films?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

People watching:

Action = 36

Sci-fi = 25

Animation = 72

Drama = 65

Horror = 83

**Formula used:**

Percentage = frac{{Group A total}}{{Group B total}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Action + Sci-fi + Animation = 36 + 25 + 72 = 133

Drama + Horror = 65 + 83 = 148

Required % = (133)/(148) times 100 approx 89.86\%

Rounded to nearest integer = **90%**

**∴ Required percentage = 90%**

questions.question:
The following bar graph shows the number of cycles produced in a factory during 4 consecutive weeks. What is the average number of cycles produced per week in these weeks?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feb3b5d98b207c2599e3eea4aac1c9edc21bd2ba640f991c4bd3526379162093.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The production of the first week = 1050

The production of the second week = 1200

The production of the third week = 950

The production of the fourth week = 1100

**Formula used:**

Average={The sum of itemsover The total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let the average production of cycle per week X

⇒ X = {1050+1200+950+1100over 4}={4300over4}={1075}

**∴ The required result will be 1075.**

questions.question:
The following bar graph shows the number of males, number of females and total population of four different villages. Find the total number of children in the four villages.

Total population = Number of Males + Number of Females + Number of Children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aef9ed6a4c0600c5ef100cce63be9c93b3ca5132bfa539fe96e4a795b86d0156.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Children in A = 1500 - (820 + 400) = 280

Children in B = 1600 - (1040 + 320) = 240

Children in C = 1400 - (760 + 420) = 220

Children in D = 1000 - (580 + 300) = 120

Total number of children in all the villages = 280 + 240 + 220 + 120 = 860

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
